records.title: Navigating the depths: a case study of decompression sickness and oxygen toxicity in a pilot subjected to hypobaric and hyperbaric chamber exposures
records.locator: 2025 AsMA Scientific Sessions, abstract 208, Case Presentation
records.note: The presenting symptoms were described as consistent with DCS. Oxygen toxicity during hyperbaric treatment is a distinct subsequent event. The published case does not supply a training exposure denominator.
records.case_comparison: Gentry 2017 reports first symptoms at three hours and describes subsequent recurrent symptoms. Belmonte 2024 describes evening wrist symptoms and resolution with first recompression. Neither matches the delayed symptom report and treatment complication sequence in abstract 208. Participant linkage is unavailable.
